thought.text: Commit to main! Jetze auf VPS deployen:

reasoning_content: Done! Now let me deploy to VPS and verify:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Pulled main:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -2")

import time
time.sleep(8)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
